prompts:
The ferry company's boarding screens play a short recorded announcement. The next one is this sentence:

"Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors."

Deliver it as spoken audio in `./announcement.wav`, a WAV file of 4 to 8 seconds that a passenger can understand.
diff:
A check_tools.ps1
A diag.ps1
A diag2.ps1
A make_announcement.ps1

--- check_tools.ps1 ---
foreach ($c in 'python','python3','dotnet','espeak','espeak-ng','powershell.exe','ffmpeg','sox','nls') {
    $p = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($p) { Write-Host "$c : $($p.Source)" } else { Write-Host "$c : MISSING" }
}


--- diag.ps1 ---
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$asm = [System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName("System.Speech")
Write-Host "Assembly: $($asm.FullName)"
Write-Host "Location: $($asm.Location)"
Write-Host "Version: $($asm.Version)"
Write-Host "--- Types containing 'OutputFormat' ---"
$asm.GetTypes() | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*OutputFormat*" } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.FullName }
Write-Host "--- Types containing 'Synthesizer' ---"
$asm.GetTypes() | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*Synthesizer*" } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.FullName }
Write-Host "--- All top-level type names (first 40) ---"
$asm.GetTypes() | ForEach-Object { $_.Name } | Select-Object -First 40


--- diag2.ps1 ---
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$ts = [System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer]
Write-Host "=== Properties ==="
$ts.GetProperties() | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.Name }
Write-Host "=== Methods ==="
$ts.GetMethods() | Where-Object { $_.DeclaringType -eq $ts } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.ToString() }


--- make_announcement.ps1 ---
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$ts = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer
Write-Host "=== Installed voices ==="
foreach ($v in $ts.GetInstalledVoices()) {
    Write-Host "$($v.Name) | $($v.Language) | Gender=$($v.Gender)"
}
Write-Host "=== Default voice ==="
Write-Host "$($ts.Voice.Name) | $($ts.Voice.Language)"

$ts.SetOutputToWaveFile("announcement.wav")
$ts.Rate = 0
$ts.Speak("Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors.")
$ts.Dispose()
Write-Host "=== Generated. File size: ==="
if (Test-Path "announcement.wav") { Write-Host "$(Get-Item announcement.wav).Length bytes" } else { Write-Host "NOT FOUND" }
